name: Optimals  Quick Relief Gummies [10-Pack] | 50mg
description:
Per Package: 50mg CBC, 50mg CBG, 50mg THC, 10mg Beta-Caryophyllene 

Per Piece: 5mg CBC, 5mg CBG, 5mg THC, 1mg Beta-Caryophyllene 

Attack aches and pains from every angle! This fast-acting formulation pairs three specialized cannabinoids with the anti-inflammatory terpene Beta-Caryophyllene to potentially reduce swelling, regulate the receptors that control physical sensation, and help relieve the stress you feel when your body isn’t at its best. They have a 5-15 minute onset and 2-4 hour duration. And like all Wana edibles, they're vegan, naturally melt-proof, and made with organic sweeteners.
